line: A new night-shift hire films their first night in an endless yellow office, following the rules on the wall.
line_cn: 新夜班员工拍下入职第一晚：无尽的黄色办公空间，和墙上的员工守则。

camera.move: Slow pan off a detail to the space
Crouch and hold on printed text
Zoom + focus hunt into the distance
Identical framing after a tear, only the OSD changed

camera.serves: leaving a room; a rule broken

camera.move: Camera set down on a surface, static, recording alone
camera.serves: the operator gone; a long wait

camera.move: Whip toward a sound, then nothing

labels: Closed captions (CEA-608 style): a monospace (e.g. IBM Plex Mono 600) ~42 px, white on a solid black box per row, ≤ 32 characters, centred inside the 4:3 frame above the OSD. Untouched by tape noise (the TV decodes them). Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Speaker marks: [PA] for announcements, italics for the operator, SDH descriptions in brackets ([LIGHTS FLICKER], [TAPE NOISE], [SILENCE]).

Rules on notices are not captioned: they are the picture. Readable at 1080p, ≥ 3–4 s uncovered. For close-ups lower the camera so the lens is parallel to the page; pitching down at a vertical sheet shears words into fake italics.
The title is camcorder title-generator text over the first shot.
motion: One continuous handheld take. Cuts happen only where the tape breaks: power-on roll-in, tracking tear, REC off.
Handheld = walking gait (head bob a few cm, sway, small roll) + breathing (~0.27 Hz) + tremor noise at a few frequencies whose amplitude follows a fear curve. At a held breath, freeze all of it.
Looking down shows only shoe toes and floor, never legs.
Autofocus = focus distance animated with overshoot: blur → lock → slip → lock. Blur comes from pulling focus near. Zoom narrows the FOV and opens the aperture.

native_moves.name: Autofocus / auto-exposure hunting
native_moves.does: Something is there only while focus is correct.
native_moves.fits: a missing pet on a hotel floor; a figure in an empty stadium; a shape at the end of a hospital corridor.

native_moves.name: Tape tracking damage
native_moves.does: A tear is a cut the universe made; same framing after, but the clock jumped, the battery drained, a light died.
native_moves.fits: a night-watch log; a lost weekend in a mall; a house that ages between tapes.

native_moves.name: The OSD is plot
native_moves.does: REC, battery, date and time code are evidence.
native_moves.fits: an alibi; a countdown; a dated inspection.

native_moves.name: Rules as text in frame
native_moves.does: Notices and PA announcements start ordinary, drift wrong, contradict each other, and finally address the viewer.
native_moves.fits: a pool's safety rules; a school fire drill; a museum after hours.

native_moves.name: Emptiness and repetition
native_moves.does: The same notice in a different place; the same room with one detail changed; a corridor into fog.
native_moves.fits: a moving-day walkthrough; an airport at 4 a.m.; an office after layoffs.

native_moves.name: The thing that is almost human
native_moves.does: A distant silhouette wrong by 15–40 % (small head, long neck, narrow high shoulders, long arms), drawn as organic curves on a billboard, moving slowly.
native_moves.fits: a mannequin that is not; a night guard; a reflection that lags.

score.note: no score: music only inside the world (hold music, PA jingle), filtered
